letter.subject: Request to Opt Out of Arbitration Clause
letter.body:
[Your name]
[Your address]
[Date]

Orbit Wireless Customer Service
[Orbit Wireless Address for Arbitration Opt-Out - if specified, otherwise general customer service address]

Dear Orbit Wireless,

I am writing to formally opt out of the binding individual arbitration provision as stated in Section 8 of my Plan Agreement, signed on [Date of signing].

I understand that by opting out, I retain my right to pursue disputes in a court of law, rather than through arbitration.

Please confirm receipt of this opt-out request.

Sincerely,
[Your name]

text:
ORBIT WIRELESS — PLAN AGREEMENT
Plan: Orbit Everyday Unlimited   Device: Pixelon 9 Pro (256 GB)

SUMMARY OF CHARGES
Plan price: $42.00/month, fixed for 24 months   Device: $0 down, $27.50/month for 24 months

1. PLAN PRICE. Your plan price is $42.00 per month and will not increase during the 24-month term of this agreement.

2. FEES. There is no activation fee and no monthly administrative fee. Taxes and government-required charges are billed as they apply.

3. DEVICE PAYMENTS. You agree to pay the device price of $660.00 in 24 equal monthly installments of $27.50. There is no interest.

4. TERM AND CANCELLATION. This agreement has a 24-month term. You may cancel service at any time by phone, online, or in a store. If you cancel early, the remaining device balance becomes due. There is no early termination fee.

5. DATA. Your plan includes unlimited data. After 50 GB of data use in a billing cycle, Orbit may slow your data speeds during times of network congestion.

6. AUTOMATIC RENEWAL. After the 24-month term, your plan continues month to month at the same price until you cancel. Orbit will give you 60 days' notice before any price change.

7. RETURN POLICY. You may cancel and return the device within thirty (30) days of purchase for a full refund.

8. DISPUTES. You may bring disputes in small-claims court or through binding individual arbitration. You may opt out of arbitration within 30 days of signing.

Customer Signature: ____________________   Date: __________

clauses.quote: Your plan price is $42.00 per month and will not increase during the 24-month term of this agreement.
clauses.title: Fixed plan price
clauses.meaning: Your monthly service fee will not change for the first 24 months.
clauses.whyItMatters: The $42.00 you pay for service is guaranteed for two years. Orbit Wireless cannot raise this price on you.
clauses.whatToDo: Keep this document. It confirms your fixed price.

clauses.quote: You agree to pay the device price of $660.00 in 24 equal monthly installments of $27.50. There is no interest.
clauses.title: No interest on device
clauses.meaning: You are paying for the phone in 24 monthly installments. You are not charged interest on these payments.
clauses.whyItMatters: You pay the exact retail price of the phone, $660.00, spread over two years. You are not paying extra for financing.
clauses.whatToDo: Confirm the Pixelon 9 Pro (256 GB) costs $660.00 if bought outright.

clauses.quote: If you cancel early, the remaining device balance becomes due. There is no early termination fee.
clauses.title: Device balance due on cancellation
clauses.meaning: If you end your service before 24 months, you must pay the rest of your phone's cost immediately.
clauses.whyItMatters: If you cancel after 12 months, you still owe 12 x $27.50 = $330.00 for the phone. This amount is due at once.
clauses.whatToDo: Understand that leaving early means a lump sum payment for your phone. Budget for this if you plan to switch providers.

clauses.quote: After 50 GB of data use in a billing cycle, Orbit may slow your data speeds during times of network congestion.
clauses.title: Data speed may slow
clauses.meaning: Your 'unlimited' data might get slower if you use more than 50 GB in a month and the network is busy.
clauses.whyItMatters: If you are a heavy data user, your internet speed could drop significantly after 50 GB, making streaming or browsing difficult.
clauses.whatToDo: Check your typical monthly data usage. If it's often over 50 GB, ask Orbit Wireless about their typical throttling speeds.

clauses.quote: After the 24-month term, your plan continues month to month at the same price until you cancel. Orbit will give you 60 days' notice before any price change.
clauses.title: Auto-renews monthly
clauses.meaning: After two years, your plan automatically switches to a monthly contract at the same price. Orbit Wireless must tell you 60 days before they change this price.
clauses.whyItMatters: You won't be locked into another long-term contract, but the price could change after the initial 24 months. You will get notice.
clauses.whatToDo: Mark your calendar for month 22 to review your plan options. Compare Orbit Wireless's new offer with competitors.

clauses.quote: You may bring disputes in small-claims court or through binding individual arbitration. You may opt out of arbitration within 30 days of signing.
clauses.title: Arbitration or small claims
clauses.meaning: You must resolve disagreements with Orbit Wireless either in small claims court or through a private arbitration process. You can choose not to use arbitration if you tell them within 30 days.
clauses.whyItMatters: Arbitration means you give up your right to sue Orbit Wireless in a regular court or join a class-action lawsuit. Small claims court has limits on how much money you can claim.
clauses.whatToDo: If you prefer to keep your right to sue in court, send a written notice to Orbit Wireless within 30 days stating you opt out of arbitration.

terms.plain: This means a private third party will decide any dispute you have with Orbit Wireless, and you cannot appeal their decision in court.
